hero.tagline: I build precise, scalable web products — from pixel-accurate UIs to production APIs. Currently shipping at Terapage.

about.label: 01 / About
about.heading: Detail-oriented engineer. <signal>Chemistry graduate</signal> who codes.
about.p1: I'm a Full-Stack & Frontend Developer based in <chalk>Lagos, Nigeria</chalk>, currently contributing to <signal>Terapage</signal> — a live research activity management platform — where I own full-stack architecture across six distinct activity types, collaborating directly with designers and leading both frontend and backend development.
about.p2: My background in <chalk>B.Sc. Chemistry from the University of Lagos</chalk> gives me a scientist's approach to debugging — systematic, patient, and rigorous. I bring that same precision to TypeScript strict mode, pixel-accurate UI work, and ESLint compliance.
about.p3: Expert in the <chalk>MERN stack and Next.js App Router</chalk>, with a strong focus on robust authentication, performance-optimised frontends, and clean RESTful APIs. Currently also building the Terapage React Native mobile app.

skills.heading: Technical
skills.body: Six years of deliberate practice across the full stack — from pixel-accurate UIs to production-grade APIs and mobile apps.

projects.heading: Projects &
projects.body: A cross-section of production work and practice projects — authentication systems, full-stack apps, e-commerce interfaces, and an in-progress mobile platform.

auth.title: Full-Stack Next.js Authentication System
auth.description: Secure auth boilerplate with registration, login, and profile management. JWT via HTTP-only cookies, Bcrypt hashing, and a Middleware gatekeeper for route protection.

quiz.title: Country Quiz Master
quiz.description: Ultra-fast geography quiz with 100 dynamic questions on global flags and capitals. Smart scoring engine uses TypeScript Record state mapping to prevent double-scoring.

tracker.title: MERN Exercise Tracker
tracker.description: Full-stack CRUD app for exercise log management. RESTful API with Node.js/Express and schema-based data modelling via Mongoose and MongoDB Atlas.

jumia.title: Jumia E-commerce Interface & Weather Dashboard
jumia.description: Fully responsive Jumia frontend clone using Atomic Design principles. Persistent Dark/Light theme engine via Redux and localStorage. Calculation logic validated with Jest/Vitest.

terapage.title: Terapage Mobile (In Progress)
terapage.description: React Native Participant app for the Terapage research platform. Built on Expo SDK 51+, Expo Router v3, Zustand, TanStack Query, and NativeWind.

experience.heading: Experience &
experience.eduNote: Scientific rigour applied to software — systematic debugging, precise analysis, zero-assumption problem solving.

terapage.description: Research activity management platform serving Researchers, Collaborators, Observers, and Participants.

bullets.0: Owned end-to-end frontend development for six distinct activity types — Document Review, Poll & Survey, Upload Audio/Video/Image, and Multi-Task.
bullets.1: Engineered a pixel-accurate annotation system for Document Review, resolving complex positioning bugs caused by dynamic scroll offsets and PDF viewport scaling.
bullets.2: Implemented persistent multilingual support (i18next) across all activity components, including language state hydration on page reload.
bullets.3: Built a global terminology rename spanning frontend components, backend routes, Mongoose schemas, notification templates, and transactional emails — zero regressions.
bullets.4: Developed the Participant-side Multi-Task module with search, pagination, draft visibility, and progress indicators.
bullets.5: Resolved a suite of media player bugs across Upload Audio, Video, and Image activities including subtitle sync, AI indicator display, and download functionality.
bullets.6: Initiated the Terapage React Native mobile app using Expo, TypeScript, Expo Router v3, Zustand, TanStack Query, and NativeWind.

personal.description: Independent full-stack projects spanning authentication systems, quiz apps, e-commerce UIs, and exercise trackers.
